decisions.reason: The combined robot is a core automation offering and remains aligned with the firm's integrated solutions.
The dedicated de-shuttering robot serves a specific need and has no indication of underperformance.
Profile storage automation supports the integrated offering and is likely to remain in the portfolio.
The automatic shuttering robot complements the combined robot and fills a niche for customers needing standalone shuttering.
Launched only in 2024 as a product line with several models, it is too early to drop and likely still being promoted.
Production analysis software is close to the established offer and provides value, so it is expected to stay.
